summary: Peoples Bancorp filed an 8-K with an exhibit containing a September 30, 2026 conference-call transcript discussing its proposed merger with Capital Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: CBNK); Peoples would be the acquirer. No price per share, premium, stake, or expected closing date is stated in the excerpt. The filing is made under Rule 425 and deemed solicitation material under Rule 14a-12, the US equivalent of merger-proxy communications. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for definitive merger-agreement terms, exchange ratio, regulatory approval clock, and shareholder votes as the arb spread catalyst.
